text:
Type: tassel trim throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary, modern
Materials: slubbed linen-look woven fabric, cotton tassels
Colors: warm terracotta orange, grey, beige, white tassels
Shape: square, solid color with a horizontal row of mini tassels across the middle, fine texture, knife edges, compact
Feel: warm, playful, cheerful
Goes with: cream or grey sofas, natural wood, leather, rust tones; bohemian or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Tassel Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Terracotta
product.description: Made in the United States and imported This bold terracotta throw pillow draws the eye and makes a statement with its vibrant burnt-orange hue. A muted neutral border and tassels add a dramatic, classy touch of fun. 17"L x 17"W Spot Clean.
